annotations.title: Working Days and Hours in a Year or Month

description: Count the working days and working hours in a calendar year or in one month of it. Weekends (Saturday and Sunday) are skipped, and so are the holidays you list that fall on a weekday. Send the year, optionally a month, the hours in a working day (default 8) and your holiday dates. Get back the weekdays, the holidays taken off, the working days, the working hours and the holidays that did not change the count (weekend, repeated or in another month). Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/workday-hours-year). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

holidays.description: Optional: days off, each YYYY-MM-DD, all in the year you ask about (up to 60). The calculator does not know any holiday: you send them.

label.description: Optional label (your own text, echoed back; not a person's name).

month.description: Optional: one month of the year, 1 to 12. Leave out for the whole year.
